Specification: This module defines a small TLA+ model intended to exercise folding over a set of function-domain elements using an Apalache-specific operator. It declares an integer variable x with a trivial behavior: the initial state sets x to 0 and the next-state relation leaves x unchanged forever. The interesting assertion is a state predicate Inv, which compares the result of ApaFoldSet applied to an update operator A, an initial function f, and the domain of f against the function that maps every domain element to 1; the comments explain that the specification intentionally asserts the negation of the invariant that should actually hold in order to check that the SMT encoding is properly constrained and yields UNSAT.
